card.name: The digit 2 inside numbers and lists
card.fires_on: The digit 2 (or roman numeral ii) right after a verse colon, a year start, or a list marker, usually where a number is partly written and a following digit or bracket is expected.

modes.label: Bible verse numbers
modes.description: The digit 2 as the first digit of a verse number after a chapter and colon.

modes.label: Numbered list items
modes.description: The number 2 or roman ii marking the second item in a numbered list.

modes.label: Digits in dates and measures
